sourceFacts: Source #142 describes beginning around six reps and building toward sets of twenty.
Paired deadlift preparation and substantial single-bell experience remain separate requirements.
appDecisions: Optional existing-doubleSwing profile; default doubleHinge remains unchanged.
Two fixed sets, two-rep steps from 6 to 20, 90-second rests, four seconds per rep planning estimate and clean-exposure gates are app choices.
Ordinary repetitions remain untimed; no timer grants work credit.
Independent comparison identity; returning to this profile after another starts a fresh comparison cycle.
Endpoint maintains current load until an owned permitted increment is explicitly selected.
limits: Not a complete source-authored paired-kettlebell program.
No compulsory 60% load conversion, sex-specific targets, fixed-year qualification or automatic admission to paired work.
No broader paired clean/press/squat gate changes.

quotes.quote: you may start with something like six reps but you build up towards sets of 20
we always work on the deadlift before we introduce the swing
